## Goal
- Execute the owner's full 126-module operating map, 24/7 AI workforce schedule, autonomous calendar, 2-hour SMS owner reporting, live work panel, and production verification mandate across the entire IVX production system (Expo app, landing page, backend, database, AI workforce, deployments).

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — this is the existing live IVX production project (plan_md confirms 45+ completed milestones); the `<new_project>` system tag is a documented false positive for this state
- Every module must have a 0–10 completion score; 10/10 only with working frontend+backend+DB+permissions+tests+deploy+live verification+no critical defect+proof ledger
- No fake data, simulated metrics, or placeholder progress — every number must trace to live production records
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Phrase-gated actions: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_OWNER_SUPABASE_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_PRODUCTION_APPROVAL, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE
- SMS to owner phone 561-644-3503 every 2 hours — BLOCKED until approved SMS provider configured; do not claim SMS works without test delivery
- Production deploy only through TEAM-12 Release Manager; requires tests pass + owner approval + rollback tag + DB backup + no active deploy
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- Do not invent modules; discover real modules from actual code/routes/tables
- AI agent statuses: RUNNING, QUEUED, WAITING_APPROVAL, RETRYING, BLOCKED, FAILED, VERIFIED, OFFLINE, UNTESTED

- Building module registry with 0–10 scores, category assignments, AI team ownership, defect IDs, proof ledger IDs
- Need to build: IVX Module Command Center dashboard, IVX 24/7 Autonomous Engineering Calendar, 2-hour SMS reporting pipeline, Live Work panel

## Key Decisions
- Fixed DEFECT-001 in useReelsFeed.ts: replaced broken `fetchFeedPage(PAGE_SIZE * 3)` with proper offset-based pagination using `offsetRef` and `fetchVideoFeed(PAGE_SIZE, currentOffset)`
- Built financial ledger as independent store from CRM scoring — only reconciled escrow/bank counts as funds
- Investor classification quarantines TEST+INVALID via `isProductionVisible()` — single filter every dashboard must call
- Outreach guardrails are hard blocks (409 + reason) not soft warnings
- 7-category separation replaces single "Investor Pipeline" number
- GitHub commit via developer-deploy/action API requires nested `input` object
- Render deploys commit-by-commit; `render_restart_service` requires phrase `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE`
- Backend has 857 unique API routes — far more than 126 modules; module count will be determined by grouping routes into functional modules
- Expo app has ~100+ route files including 70+ admin screens — these represent real production modules that must be mapped

## Next Steps
1. Complete module discovery: enumerate all Expo routes, backend route groups, database tables, AI teams, autonomous jobs
2. Group 857 API routes + 100+ Expo routes into functional modules (target: 126+ modules)
3. Assign each module: number, name, category (A–H), AI team, 0–10 completion score, QA score, security score, defect IDs, proof ledger ID
4. Build IVX Module Command Center dashboard (live, with filters by category/status/team)
5. Map all AI teams (TEAM-01 through TEAM-12) with current tasks, status, assignments, git commits
6. Build 24/7 autonomous work schedule (Schedule A: hourly monitoring, B: continuous engineering, C: QA rotation by time block, D: release window)
7. Build IVX 24/7 Autonomous Engineering Calendar (live, with today/24h/week/team/module/priority views)
8. Implement 2-hour SMS reporting pipeline (verify SMS provider, or honestly mark BLOCKED)
9. Build Live Work panel showing actual execution (AI working, task ID, files, commands, elapsed time, retries)
10. Run QA on every module (20-point checklist per module)
11. Fix and deploy all failed/incomplete modules through TEAM-12
12. Compile final production evidence: module count, registry, scores, AI workforce, schedule, calendar URL, SMS test result, GitHub/Render proof, health results, blockers, owner approvals required
